events.title: Silicon Laboratories (SLAB) Surpasses Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: Silicon Labs (SLAB) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +8.16% and +0.08%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
